Every post executes the given angle — the metric changed and here is what to request instead

context.label: The angle you are executing — do not change it
context.body:
Angle: a metric developers still request was deprecated, and the
replacement has a different name. Useful, non-alarming, practical.

You are executing this angle. You did not choose it and you may not substitute
another. Do not make it a 'Meta breaks things again' complaint post, and do not
broaden it into general API-deprecation commentary.

context.label: The evidence you may draw on, and nothing beyond it
context.body:
Verified by a prior research task (20260729-rd-005), sourced to
developers.facebook.com:

- Per-media `impressions` is deprecated for Instagram media created on or after
  2 July 2024. For media created before that date it is still returned.
- The deprecation applied to all API versions on 21 April 2025, per the Graph
  API v22.0 changelog.
- The changelog names `views` as the new unified metric. NOTE: the current
  endpoint reference lists `views` but does not itself label it the replacement,
  so 'replacement' traces to the changelog only.

Do not state any other date, metric name, or version number. If you want to say
something the evidence above does not support, leave it out.

context.label: Audience and channel
context.body:
Developers who integrate the Instagram Graph API. Single-channel
short-form text, no thread, no images. Plain and specific beats clever.

constraints: Three posts, each under 280 characters. No emoji. At most one hashtag per post. Do not invent metrics, dates, or version numbers beyond the supplied evidence. Where the evidence is marked unconfirmed, do not state it as settled.
out_of_scope: Do not fact-check the supplied evidence — that was a prior task. Do not choose a different angle. Do not schedule, publish, or recommend a posting time; marketing owns that. Do not write a thread or long-form version.
